## Description

Requires short-, medium-, and long-horizon signals to agree before opening or retaining a directional position.

## Where it may fit

Cleaner, persistent trends where confirmation is worth entering later; usually trades less often than a single-timeframe system.

## Vehicles

Equity ETFs, futures, FX, crypto; tactical allocation overlays.

## Required data

Synchronized OHLCV at multiple resolutions, session calendars, point-in-time bars.

## Caveats

Higher-timeframe candles must not leak unfinished future bars into lower-timeframe decisions.
